app.name: Listorez2047
tooltip.manual_input: Open every field on the current page with existing recognized values for manual review and correction.
ui.auto.tooltip: Recognize all names and save. Preview stays available: zoom, pan, and Save view.
ui.overlap.tooltip: When frames overlap: clip the other field out of this one, or OCR the full rectangle.
dialog.rotate.title: Rotate page
dialog.duplicate.title: File already exists
dialog.candidates.title: Several matches
dialog.notext.title: No text layer
dialog.notext.body: This page has no text. Enable OCR?
dialog.auto_report.title: Auto finished
dialog.config.title: OCR configuration
about.body: Listorez2047 is an offline PDF splitter: one page per file, names from a template. OCR is used only to build the filename. Engine: RapidOCR / PP-OCRv5.
warn.fields_renumbered: Fields were renumbered. Check the filename template.
status.draw_field: Draw the field rectangle on the page
error.encrypted: The file is password protected and cannot be opened.
error.bad_pdf: Could not open the PDF. It may be damaged.
error.save: Could not save the page. Check the folder and file access.
error.language_required: At least one OCR language must be enabled.
dialog.empty_pattern.body: This field has no pattern. Continue with raw text from its frame?
dialog.empty_pattern.auto: Some fields have no pattern. Continue the batch with raw frame text?
dialog.profile.replace: Replace current fields with fields from the profile?
config.dpi.label: OCR DPI
config.dpi.tooltip: OCR raster resolution. 300 balances quality, memory and speed. It does not affect preview.
config.ocr_max_side.label: Maximum side
config.ocr_max_side.tooltip: Maximum OCR raster side in pixels. 3508 is about A4 at 300 DPI.
config.cpu_threads.label: CPU threads
config.cpu_threads.tooltip: ONNX threads within one page: 1 to 4, default 2.
config.use_angle_cls.label: Angle classifier
config.drop_score.label: Minimum confidence
config.drop_score.tooltip: Text blocks below this score are discarded. 0.5 is balanced.
config.det_limit_side_len.label: Detector size
config.det_limit_side_len.tooltip: RapidOCR detector size. Larger helps small text but uses more memory.
config.rec_batch_num.label: Recognition batch
config.rec_batch_num.tooltip: Text blocks per recognition batch. 4–8 is normal.
config.lang_eslav.label: Russian
config.lang_eslav.tooltip: Russian and East Slavic recognition model.
config.lang_latin.label: Latin
config.lang_latin.tooltip: Latin languages: EN, DE, FR, ES and others.
config.lang_chinese.label: Chinese
config.lang_chinese.tooltip: The Chinese model is larger and disabled by default.
config.prefer_native_text.label: PDF text first
config.prefer_native_text.tooltip: Use the existing PDF text layer first on digital pages.
config.field_padding_pct.label: Field padding, %
config.field_padding_pct.tooltip: Expands the field region to avoid clipping character edges.
help.pattern.month: Date with a month word: use DD.M.DDDD; the filename always receives 01.06.2026.
dialog.auto_empty.title: Auto stopped: empty fields
dialog.auto_empty.body: Page {page} has values required for the filename that were not recognized. Fill them before saving.
dialog.auto_empty.required: Fill every listed field or skip the page.
dialog.auto_empty.filename_required: The resulting filename cannot be empty.
tooltip.field.label: A readable field name, such as Date or Act number. It does not affect recognition.
tooltip.field.pattern: Search and normalization rule. Examples: DD.M.DDDD for a date; D{1,4} for up to 4 digits; C+ for a word.
tooltip.field.value: Result for the current page. It can always be corrected manually and is inserted into the filename as {field number}.
tooltip.ocr_language: Recognition models for this field. Select none to inherit global settings. Cyrillic is used for Russian text.
tooltip.name_template: Filename recipe. Example: Act_{1}_from_{2}_{505:+1#}. Fields use {1}, {2}; # counts successful saves.
tooltip.filename: Final name for the current page. You can edit it manually before saving.
tooltip.page_format: Expected form size. Custom exposes width and height in mm, cm, or inches.
tooltip.custom_size: Page width and height in the selected units. Changing units preserves the physical size and converts the values.
config.ocr_contrast.label: Faint-text contrast
config.ocr_contrast.tooltip: Locally enhances faint pencil before OCR. 1.0 disables it; 2–3 makes strokes clearer but may amplify paper noise.
tooltip.field.contrast: Contrast for this field only. 1.0 is unchanged; 2–3 enhances faint pencil. Press Retry field after changing it.
tooltip.field.geometry: Frame X/Y coordinates and W/H size. Units: page percent, preview pixels, mm, or cm.
dialog.recognition_review.title: Recognition review
dialog.recognition_review.retry.tooltip: Recognize only this frame again with the selected contrast, then choose the scan result or the default value.
dialog.recognition_review.value.tooltip: Dropdown: scan result and default value. You can also type your own.
status.ocr_busy: OCR is already running in the background. You can zoom, pan, and save the preview view.
tooltip.range: Allowed range: {minimum}…{maximum}. Arrow buttons and ↑/↓ stop at the limits.
tooltip.field.strategy: Preprocessing for this field from the first recognize: CLAHE for pencil; Remove gray paper background for faint gray pencil on off-white paper; adaptive threshold; line removal; upscale and sharpen. Independent of the faint-text checkbox.
tooltip.field.default_value: Inserted when OCR finds nothing. Auto still pauses for review, where the dropdown lists the scan result and this default; the value can be corrected immediately.
config.logging_enabled.label: Write log
config.logging_enabled.tooltip: Off by default. When enabled, writes startup, OCR, saves, and errors to a text file. Unhandled Qt failures are recorded too.
config.log_path.label: Log file path
config.log_path.tooltip: For a packaged exe, Listorez2047.log sits next to the program. From source it defaults to AppData/Listorez2047. You may select another writable path.
config.log_levels.label: Log levels
config.log_levels.tooltip: Choose which levels are written to the file. By default all are on: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.
error.log: Cannot open the log file. Select a writable path.
error.log_levels_required: Enable at least one log level, or turn logging off.
tooltip.output_relative: Resolved against the open PDF folder (or the profile folder). Absolute paths are allowed too. Stored in the profile with the output folder.
dialog.create_folder.title: Create folder?
error.output_not_dir:
The output path exists but is not a folder:
{path}
config.ocr_engine.label: Startup OCR engine
status.engine_error: OCR could not be loaded: {error}. Details were written to the log.
tooltip.save_view: Use the current zoom and center as the default for subsequent pages of the open PDF and Auto.
tooltip.field.default_expression: Evaluates the value for every page. Put the formula in the default value, not in the OCR pattern: {235:+1} gives 235, 236… by PDF page; {505:+1#} by successful saves; {1:+1}, {20:-1}, {2:*2}, {0:%10}. %0 produces an empty value without a crash. Mutually exclusive with remembering the last value. This frame is not OCR'd.
tooltip.field.remember_last: After Apply in review or saving the page, stores the confirmed value (including a human correction) as the initial value for the next page. A raw OCR hit is not remembered by itself. Mutually exclusive with an evaluated expression.
config.default_preprocess_strategy.label: Default OCR strategy
config.default_preprocess_strategy.toolt: New field frames inherit this strategy immediately. You can change it on the field without Retry: it already applies to the first Recognize page and to Auto.
config.reset_windows.tooltip: While the app is running, Auto progress, review, and other dialogs stay where you dragged them. This button puts them back. After a restart they start at the default place again.
warn.expression.empty: Field {id}: Evaluate expression is on, but the formula is empty. Put it in the default value, e.g. {{235:+1}} — not in the OCR pattern.
warn.expression.invalid: Field {id}: formula “{pattern}” is not valid. Use {{235:+1}} or {{505:+1#}} in the default value.
warn.pattern.counter: Field {id}: “{pattern}” is a filename formula, not an OCR pattern. Move it to the default value and turn on Evaluate expression.
warn.pattern.invalid: Field {id}: pattern “{pattern}” could not be read. Fix it, or leave it empty for raw frame text.
